findings.observation: 15 seconds bounds a cooperative post-Popen polling interval. Popen starts after deadline creation but cannot be preempted by that polling. Three Git commands each allow15seconds before and after; recursive prior hashing, selected source hashing and packaging have no aggregate deadline. Termination can wait3seconds twice; joins allow2seconds per stream; close and other native/filesystem operations can block.
findings.required: One total action budget including preflight, execution, termination, drain and evidence; separately qualified enclosing watchdog for blocked native operations. No hard-total claim from Python clock alone.

findings.observation: Retained stdout32768/stderr65536 caps exist. Reader completion is used as EOF proxy and parse additionally requires no reader errors. No explicit per-stream EOF; post-join still-live readers may mutate buffers/counters while snapshot/close proceeds. Read errors do not interrupt the polling child immediately.
findings.required: Explicit per-stream EOF, errors and immutable settled snapshot; overflow/read-error cancellation; no success after missing EOF or physical exit, no blocking close while a reader owns its stream.

findings.observation: argv selects old original receipt executable, not the new explicit candidate. No executable byte count/hash or named/opened current identity is bound.
findings.required: A separately reviewed private action binding selects the exact candidate, validates executable hash/size and meaningful identity evidence, and retains repository/original-output from the preserved original receipt.

findings.observation: Fixed destination is occupied according to the parent. mkdir(exist_ok=False) fails safely when occupied, but allocates before ancestry checks and recursive prior evidence reads have no explicit membership/bounds. Archive is fixed too.
findings.required: Bind a distinct caller-owned fresh destination; validate ancestry before exclusive allocation; never overwrite originals or infer a new fallback path. Preserve a fixed reviewed prior evidence list rather than recursively discovering arbitrary files.

findings.observation: Module import performs filesystem writes and later child execution. Twenty-two asserts guard acceptance and preservation; optimized Python can remove them.
findings.required: No work on import; explicit handled refusal checks. No execution CLI becomes authorized by source acceptance.

findings.observation: Original output-parent bracket includes dev/inode/mode/attributes/size/mtime/ctime but not atime. Parent reports separate candidate hash/bracket evidence with complete-field instability; its exact predicate/source and full supporting JSON are not yet relayed.
findings.required: Preserve existing guards; request exact supporting predicate before changing any criterion. Distinguish identity/security fields and read-sensitive timestamps in reporting only. Do not claim full bracket stability, distributor trust, loaded closure or hostile reverted-mutation resistance.
